function.name: archive_documents
function.description: Archives a list of documents based on document IDs and an optional expiration date for archival. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

document_ids.description: A list of unique identifier strings for the documents to be archived.

expire_date.description: The expiration date for the archival in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2023-12-31'. If not provided, defaults to 'null' which implies no expiration.

notify_user.description: Flag indicating whether to notify the user upon successful archival. Defaults to false.

message.content: Shashi Tej Reddy (born 1975) is an Indian entrepreneur best known for founding the online marketplace **Shopify India**—a localized version of the global e‑commerce platform Shopify tailored for Indian merchants. He previously worked at **Amazon**, where he helped launch Amazon.in’s first product line. After leaving Amazon, he co‑founded Shopify India with his partner, focusing on providing local payment solutions, logistics integration, and marketing support for small businesses. In addition to his entrepreneurial work, Shashi has served on advisory boards for several tech incubators in Bangalore and mentors startups through the **TechStars Bangalore Accelerator** program.
